acceptance_definitions.class_applicability: Approved rule list names edition, clause, covered equipment classes and streams; reviewer signs applicability to this telemetry.
acceptance_definitions.defect_container_namespaces: Container codebook located; linkage key to ledger/telemetry proven on samples; typeless rows classified, not assumed.
acceptance_definitions.outcome_severity_validity: Owner-validated outcome set with asset linkage, timestamps, and state semantics; single-row candidates never promoted alone.
acceptance_definitions.telemetry_to_ledger_mapping: Named IDs match exactly on a documented key; namespaces, normalizations, and exceptions recorded; owner confirms scope.
acceptance_definitions.timestamp_cadence: Timezone/offset and interval encoding stated by the data owner; gaps attributable; equal-spacing claims still require cadence proof.
acceptance_definitions.units_scaling_sign: Unit, scaling factor, and sign stated per code from metering documentation or reviewer ruling; CT/PT effects ruled in or out explicitly.
acceptance_definitions.zero_operating_state: Metering documentation or ruling distinguishes de-energized readings from missing data per code; no global zero rule assumed.
